about_en:
Applied AI engineer and team lead with 8+ years shipping software in Mongolia across government, banking and consumer products. I train and ship models for a low-resource language and build grounded LLM products end to end.
• Mongolian drama dubbing model: built a 92-hour, 95-speaker speech corpus, fine-tuned a voice model with emotion training, plus a QA gate matching human review 87-93%. Demo: nasanochir.github.io/mongolian-ai-dubbing
• Open Parliament (3rd place): grounded AI over 950 laws, built only on official open government data.
• astro.mn: paid LLM product; facts computed in code so the model can't invent numbers.
• Mongolian spell checker: 96% top-1 accuracy vs 72% for the market leader.
Previously led mobile teams on a national e-library and an 8,500-seat arena platform, built bank apps, and shipped loyalty, ordering and enterprise apps for GS25, APU and Shunkhlai Group.

bullets_en: Campus super-app (main developer; Flutter, Riverpod, Firebase): built the app from scratch, including a host for web mini-apps (food ordering, meeting rooms, facility, events, parking) that passes login tokens and handles navigation, and an indoor wayfinding map with a building directory.

GS25 Mongolia: built the retail loyalty app from its first version (eBarimt e-receipts, vouchers, coupons, in-app shop, wallet passes, WebSockets) and the loyalty/CRM admin dashboards. Top contributor to the e-receipt panel: batch sending, eBarimt matching, SSO and roles, Docker CI/CD.

DOT B2B ordering apps (top contributor; Flutter): started and built the customer ordering app (catalog, per-company cart, discounts, order templates, branch management, finance statements, asset and fridge tracking, push notifications) and the sales-rep ordering app.

APU Dairy and APU Route: started and built the APU Dairy milk-collection app (React Native/Expo; procurement, driver and lab workflows, offline sync, Bluetooth receipt printing) and built the APU Route fuel accounting system (Next.js, AG Grid; fuel calculations, vehicles, Excel reports).

Car parking admin and POS monitoring: restructured the parking admin panel per the PRD and built reports with CSV/PDF export, settlement reconciliation, user groups with CSV import, pricing setup and the payment front end. Built a POS fleet monitoring dashboard.
goOrange: Microsoft Teams peer-recognition app with a bot, Microsoft Graph-synced directory and an MCP agent interface (3rd place, Shunkhlai Hackathon).
Shunkhlai Group (contributor): e-Mongolia and QPay integration, notifications and loyalty features in the Orange consumer app; delivery history in the B2B driver app.
AI: Mongolian meeting transcription and AI meeting notes SaaS. Designed Shunkhlai Group's 4-module employee AI training program.
Led a mobile team of about 5 people.

Esan, national digital library (iOS, Android): project lead with a team of 8 on Mongolia's national e-library for ebooks, audiobooks, theses, newspapers and magazines, with offline reading. Integrated the Readium SDK for EPUB rendering with pagination, highlights and reading-position sync.
Steppe Arena app: delivered the app for the 8,500-seat AIC Steppe Arena with event and sports ticketing, in-seat food ordering, ice-skating session booking and plate-based smart-parking payment.
Odin Survey: built a survey and market-research platform (web, iOS, Android) where users earn points and coupons and business clients get aggregated insights.

Built and maintained mobile banking apps for major Mongolian banks: Arig Bank, XacBank, Golomt Bank and Trade and Development Bank (TDB). Work covered secure login, accounts, transfers, card management and payments.
Developed the consumer apps Shuffle and Elify.
Worked within a fintech vendor building payments, merchant and loyalty infrastructure under banking security and compliance requirements.

Full-stack work on government e-service systems: early e-Mongolia platform work, the Ulaanbaatar city e-services portal (e-service.ulaanbaatar.mn), and my.tog.mn, the Ulaanbaatar Electricity Distribution Network customer portal for bills, consumption and service requests.

projects.desc_en: Built a ~92-hour, 95-speaker Mongolian speech corpus and fine-tuned a voice model on it, including emotion training (angry, sad, tender delivery). Per-character voice casting across a series, and an automated QA gate checking words, voice, gender, pitch and timing, with a model-based listening test that matches human review 87-93% of the time. Also reads source or burned-in subtitles, rewrites them as natural Mongolian timed to each line, and burns them into the episode.

Search and chat over parliament agendas, transcripts and 950 laws (15k articles), built only on official open government data. Facts are kept only when backed by a verbatim official quote; a validation rule threw out 345 of 550 wrong document links. 3rd place, Open Parliament Hackathon.
14 personalized long-form reading types and a chat that remembers the user. Facts are computed in code and locked into the prompt so the model can't invent numbers. Live with paid checkout.
Mobile-first Asian drama streaming for an audience that is 97% mobile, with QPay subscriptions and protected video delivery. Home of the dubbing model.

Visa application helper for Mongolian travellers covering 10 countries: passport scan autofill, document checklists with uploads, paid AI approval-chance scoring and arrival-card smart fill. Next.js 16, Supabase, Cloudflare Workers.
Contributor to a desktop manga image translator (Rust, Tauri 2, local LLMs) with text detection, OCR, inpainting and an MCP server.
96% top-1 suggestion accuracy against 72% for the market leader, on a held-out benchmark.

education.degree_en: Master's program in Computer Science and AI (completed first year, 2017-2018)
